caller_authorized.meaning: the caller of rebalanceFunds() is an authorized caller (report states no access control exists, so authorization is not enforced)

rebalance_invoked.meaning: rebalanceFunds() was invoked by a caller

event_emitted.meaning: the permissionless rebalanceFunds() call emitted events into the event logs

custodian_transfer_triggered.meaning: the permissionless rebalanceFunds() call triggered a transfer to the custodian

assumptions: rebalanceFunds() is the permissionless entry point described by p_no_access_control; the report does not name a concrete authorized role, so authorization is modeled as an observable Boolean.
The spam impact concerns repeated permissionless invocations; a single unauthorized invocation is the unit of the forbidden effect.

unresolved.description: Report does not define which callers are authorized for rebalanceFunds(), so caller_authorized is a symbolic Boolean rather than a concrete role check.

limitations: Only i_spam_events is formalized; reentrancy drain, DoS delay, and under-collateralization impacts are handled in separate passes.
The report does not state whether rebalanceFunds() actually moves funds in the spam scenario, so event emission and custodian transfer are modeled as separate observable outcomes.
